comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To expand on Elroy's original post... This item is part of the Footprints with Friends (No.1) Memorial Album. It can only be found by Pets in specific land and sea zones, and does not appear even in charted landing zone item lists.

If you wish to hunt it out for your MA, your best chance of finding it is to acquire both the Pet Training skill and a pet that has Area Search (Land) or Area Search (Sea), then spam Procurement/Collection; Additional Discovery and Pet Plunder (Land and/or Sea) can also work, but potentially at much a lower probability rate. Visit the Pet Training skill page for further details and links to some handy pet guides under the comment section.

I'm not sure about ocean zones, but according to a JP blog you can find this particular Pet MA item using a Pet with Area Search (Land) skill at the following landing points:

· Egypt North Coast
· Island of Java North Coast / Java Island Interior

Hope that helps. Cheers. (But don't expect me to share in a drink of this vile brew with you. Eugh!)

comments.body: To clarify, Elroy said this item can be found with the pet skill "Additional Discovery" but Guilder said is with the skill "Area Search (Land)". Which one? or is Additional Discovery the Google translation from JP of Area Search? Thanks for the info to both.

comments.author: ReaD
comments.body:
To my opinion, from guilder word.

both can work, just "additional discovery" need you to find discovery on the specific area by doing quest/map/etc which involve finding discovery with a chance to find the item. Pet plunder(land and/or sea) work the same but produce result(in finding the item) by fighting npc instead.

for area search(land and/or sea) need you to use collection/procure on certain same location as additional discovery. you can run the skill infinite time as long as you have the cargo and vigour.

i have yet to test this, so take this opinion with a grain of salt...
